method: static read, OEM application code not executed
findings: setKey remaps UI enum0/1/2 to254/253/255, other UI counts subtract3; the input array itself is not rewritten.
Therefore stored_code1 can be native Once or UI Toggle; import does not infer mode from the number.
setMacro consumes library actions typed0 modifier(HID224..231),1 keyboard,2 media,4 mouse and delay values.
The pinned empty sensor delay map gives zero sensor minimum; ko.setMacro maps a zero event delay to1ms.
Source getMacro does not retain every event kind: it labels non-scroll readback as Normal_Key. Files already missing that information cannot be reconstructed from bytes absent from JSON.
limits: User confirms per physical binding; raw/UI values are shown without automatic mode selection.
